about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: The initial image literal for FD DALYTRAN-REC in Cbtrn01cService is dead because 0000-DALYTRAN-OPEN and subsequent reads populate the buffer before access.
The initial image literal for FD CUSTFILE-REC is dead because 0100-CUSTFILE-OPEN and subsequent customer lookups populate the buffer before use.
Image byte 0 of s_FD_TRANFILE_REC lies in no named item and is completely overwritten during transaction output writes.
Image byte 0 of s_CARD_RECORD lies in no named item and is overwritten during card record lookups prior to field inspection.
Image byte 300 of s_TRAN_RECORD lies outside the populated transaction fields and is never read or displayed.
The initial image literal for IO-STATUS-04 is dead because Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS explicitly formats all four bytes before DISPLAY.
In id_CardXrefRecord, extending key length parameter to 17 falls back to sequential record scan in DetFiles.Indexed, finding the identical record.
The initialState arraycopy for TWO-BYTES-BINARY is dead because Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS explicitly assigns 0 to TWO-BYTES-BINARY before use.
In initialState, assigning blanks to CUST-MIDDLE-NAME is dead because 4000-READ-CUSTOMER unconditionally overwrites all customer fields from CUSTFILE.
In initialState, assigning blanks to CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD is dead because 4000-READ-CUSTOMER unconditionally overwrites customer address fields before use.
In initialState, assigning blanks to TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP is dead because 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT unconditionally moves DALYTRAN-RECORD to TRAN-RECORD.
In initialState, assigning blanks to TRAN-CARD-NUM is dead because 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT unconditionally overwrites TRAN-RECORD from the input file.

Initializing performThru array size to 65 instead of 64 has no observable effect because call stack depth in CBTRN01C never exceeds 2.
The performThru array expansion in perform() is guarded by mine == performThru.length (capacity 64), which is never reached since perform depth never exceeds 2.
The perform loop tail condition d > 0 is never evaluated because CBTRN01C only uses single-paragraph perform invocations where i == thru.
In perform(), the reverse search loop tail is entered only when a paragraph returns with i != thru, which no PERFORM statement in CBTRN01C does.
In perform(), the increment d++ in the loop tail is never executed because paragraph returns in CBTRN01C never satisfy i != thru.
The loop condition d < 0 in perform() is never reached because all PERFORM calls in CBTRN01C execute paragraphs that exit without active thru ranges.
In perform(), testing performThru[d] != i in the search loop is unreachable because CBTRN01C performs are simple single-paragraph invocations.
In perform(), inverting next >= 18 in the paragraph bounds check is unreachable because the loop tail is only entered when i != thru.
In perform(), testing next > 18 is unreachable because the paragraph dispatcher loop tail is never entered for single-paragraph performs.
In perform(), testing next < 18 in the paragraph bounds check is unreachable because CBTRN01C perform statements never return with i != thru.
In perform(), testing e.depth == mine in the PerformExit handler is unreachable because PerformExit is never thrown in CBTRN01C.

On indexed CARDFILE read, VSAM only returns status 00 or 23; terms 21, 22, and 24 are impossible, so st2.equals("23") evaluates true in both expressions.

In DetFiles.Indexed.open(mode), sequential input datasets ignore the mode string and open in read mode regardless of whether mode is INPUT or XNPUT.
